name: Diamond wa Kizutsukanai
original_name: ダイアモンドは傷つかない
source:
DD is back! Unfortunately his detective business gets closed. However, he finds a popular accessory in the luggage of the person he helped. Together with super assistant Namiko he is going to conquer the entertainment world! 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
DD回来了！不幸的是，他的侦探生意关门了。然而，他在他帮助的人的行李中发现了一件受欢迎的配饰。与超级助理奈美子一起，他将征服娱乐界！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
